title: Lost in the Noise: How Reasoning Models Fail with Contextual Distractors
reasoning: The paper's benchmark, NoisyBench, includes an 'alignment' task category with datasets like BBQ, which explicitly measures social bias. A significant portion of the analysis evaluates how distractors can induce 'emergent misalignment' and how models perform on safety benchmarks (StrongReject, HarmBench) when faced with 'jailbreaking' attempts. These evaluations of model safety and ethical alignment are a core component of the paper's research, not just a peripheral discussion.
